invariants: Scene visual output is assembled only from real temporal video Shot Assets; still images are preparation/reference inputs, never final Shot media.

fields.label: Generation policy
fields.description: Temporal synthesis policy inherited by child Shots. Image generation prepares hero/end/reference frames only; it is never an episode-render fallback.

invariants: Final Shot media must be a real video Asset produced by temporal synthesis.
Still images may only act as hero/start/end/reference anchors and can never satisfy Episode render readiness.
Temporal generation must resolve concrete input/reference Assets before expensive execution.
Queued temporal work must fail closed if the Shot revision changes before commit.

fields.label: Generation strategy
fields.description: Final temporal synthesis mode. I2V animates a hero frame; FLF2V constrains both endpoints; VIDEO is provider-native temporal synthesis. There is no animated-still fallback.

fields.label: Hero frame Asset
fields.description: Optional explicit image Asset id used as the canonical first frame for I2V/FLF2V. If empty, the latest ready Shot image generation may be used as preparation input only.

fields.label: End frame Asset
fields.description: Explicit image Asset id constraining the final frame for FLF2V.

fields.label: Temporal action prompt
fields.description: Chronological motion/action direction for the video model. Falls back to Subject action when empty. Write motion as ordered beats instead of static appearance prose.

fields.label: Temporal provider
fields.description: Explicit temporal provider id. Provider choice stays explicit in the public architecture; no hidden adaptive model selection.

invariants: Accepted identity reference Assets are durable cross-episode anchors and must never be inferred from arbitrary output files.

fields.label: Canonical image Assets
fields.description: JSON array or comma/newline-separated image Asset ids approved as canonical visual identity references.

fields.label: Accepted reference Assets
fields.description: Additional approved image/video Asset ids that may condition later shots without replacing the canonical identity set.

fields.label: Continuity policy
fields.description: How strongly temporal/image providers must use accepted reference Assets.

invariants: Accepted environment reference Assets persist across Scenes/Episodes and remain semantic anchors rather than copied prompt text.

fields.label: Canonical image Assets
fields.description: JSON array or comma/newline-separated image Asset ids defining canonical environment geometry, materials and palette.

fields.label: Accepted reference Assets
fields.description: Additional approved environment image/video Asset ids available to later Shot generations.

fields.label: Continuity policy
fields.description: How strongly generation must condition on location reference Assets.
